note: Knowledge checks are a reading check only. A pass on them is not verified practical competence.

knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Photographs and records do not establish safety or clearance. The handover states that limit.
Observations and conclusions are kept apart so that a photograph is not read as proof of cause or safety.

practicalCriteria: The learner separates observed conditions from conclusions.
The learner keeps both parties' positions and the chain of custody.
Learner completes the procedure record for the mock case and names the stop-work trigger before any practical step.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed mock decision record for the lesson case
Assessor observation of the simulated scenario, with no real site work or hazardous material
stopWorkCriteria: The chain of custody for an item is incomplete.
A conclusion about cause is written as an observation.
